description.value: Chachi's is a Canadian fast-casual sandwich chain founded in Calgary in 2006, now operating over 20 locations across BC, Alberta, and Manitoba. The Richmond outlet sits in a retail complex near YVR airport and serves a menu of gourmet focaccia and ciabatta sandwiches, mac 'n' cheese, and salads. Pick-up and delivery through multiple apps are available at this location.
